glass-horizon-story.text: Treat Rex Fleet: Glass Horizon as exploratory hard-science-fiction mystery told through human work. Discovery must emerge through observation, argument, repeatable tests, instrument behavior, piloting and consequences rather than exposition dumps. Preserve clear physical causality, natural crew acting, professional integrated lettering, and a lived-in survey-vessel culture comfortable saying 'we do not know yet.'

quiet-route-physics.text: The Quiet Route is a fragile low-tension corridor in the Aurin Rift. Temporary survey beacons can phase-couple to it and suppress local noise, making it look safer; repeated energized passage increases the correction load until a beacon can resonance-lock into the corridor and distort the path. This is physical feedback, not sentience or magic. Public green means verified low-tension safe passage; provisional survey hardware must not be presented as a certified green route.
